actions.description: Post an HTML channel message through the Microsoft Graph API when a work item is created in the configured Jira project. Graph returns 201 on success and 4xx/5xx with an error object on failure, so the HTTP status code is the success signal.

flowVariables.name: teamsMessageId
flowVariables.instruction: Id of the channel message created by Microsoft Graph. Present on a successful 201 response.

flowVariables.name: teamsErrorCode
flowVariables.instruction: Microsoft Graph error code when the send fails, for example Unauthorized, AccessDenied, ItemNotFound or InvalidAuthenticationToken.

actions.name: Post Work Item Created Message to Microsoft Teams

conditions.description: Only notify on work item created events
Only notify for work items in the configured Jira project

description: Post a Microsoft Teams channel message when a Jira work item is created

flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key to notify for. Only work items created in this project are posted to Microsoft Teams.

flowVariables.name: TEAM_ID
flowVariables.instruction: Group GUID of the target Microsoft Teams team. Read it from the groupId query parameter of the channel link produced by the channel's ... menu -> Get link to channel.

flowVariables.name: CHANNEL_ID
flowVariables.instruction: Thread id of the target channel, in the form 19:...@thread.tacv2. Read it from the URL-decoded threadId part of the channel link produced by the channel's ... menu -> Get link to channel.

name: Microsoft Teams - Notify on Work Item Created
